scope: Sparse immutable project-map projection over a prepared original inventory/index; no native/controller/compiler/model change.

overlay.scope: Same process, paired complete-index reconstruction with already prepared geometry versus sparse file-description updates; complete original output checked before timing. No browser paint, layout preparation or native compilation measurement.

data.scope: Same process, paired complete-index reconstruction with already prepared geometry versus sparse file-description updates; complete original output checked before timing. No browser paint, layout preparation or native compilation measurement.

original_actual_graph.scope: Same-process original array/filter reference resolution versus unique visibility indices; original ordered edges checked before timing. No browser rendering, native compilation or inference measurement.

navigation.scope: Five complete navigations in one fresh browser context, native host/project/OS caches retained. First and persisted geometry hits are labelled by the actual DOM attribute; older clients report null. Attached/two-rAF are navigation-relative DOM/frame proxies, not physical first paint. CPU sampling and automation add overhead. Inventory transfer, JSON parsing, input construction, layout/decoding and initial rendering are included, unlike the prepared-geometry overlay unit benchmark. No file inspection, compilation request or model inference is sent.

limits: The microbenchmark compares complete index reconstruction with prepared geometry against one sparse observation; it excludes layout/native/browser work and does not claim constant-time updates for arbitrary loaded graphs.

Real interaction captures are one sequential diagnostic run per version/project with automation/tracing/1 ms sampling overhead, normal motion and warm native/project/OS caches. Dispatch is inclusive synchronous time; two-rAF and frame intervals are not physical presentation or field INP.

Both deep drills reach the same file. Request counts and loaded declarations may differ with scheduling, so before/after long-task totals are observations rather than controlled exclusive-stage estimates.
New navigation has five fresh-context visits; its historical comparison uses the prior identical baseline-assets capture, not a fresh same-session startup baseline.
The 35 TUI and 70 GUI journeys use actual offline workers/installed tools and scripted inference; no new live-model, cold-install, local-model or confidentiality validation.
